### Ride the Current

*It catches a moving seam of water and lets the current carry its weight.*

While in water, move up to 3 squares using its printed swim speed without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. On dry ground this Maneuver has no effect.

entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Spell Screen

*A sharp gesture splinters the incoming light into a cloud of harmless sparks.*

Before one spell attack against this creature resolves, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll (or grant 1 defense Boon to its player controller). The protection belongs to this creature. For a player’s single AoE attack roll, include it when finding the worst target modifiers, as normal; do not make a separate roll or rescore outcomes for other targets. If players defend separately against an NPC area, it benefits only its own recipient. This is defensive interference, not cancellation; the resulting spell outcome still resolves.

details.flavorMarkdown: *Salt crystals cling to a sea hag's tangled hair, and her eyes reflect the shore as it looked before the last great storm.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Drowned reflection

**Target:** Only a creature that can see this creature. One visible creature within 5 squares. **Player defense:** Reason. **Damage type:** mental.

**Weak defense:** Frightened 2 of this creature. **Standard defense:** Frightened 1 of this creature.

### Ride the Current

*It catches a moving seam of water and lets the current carry its weight.*

While in water, move up to 3 squares using its printed swim speed without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. On dry ground this Maneuver has no effect.

### Spell Screen

*A sharp gesture splinters the incoming light into a cloud of harmless sparks.*

Before one spell attack against this creature resolves, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll (or grant 1 defense Boon to its player controller). The protection belongs to this creature. For a player’s single AoE attack roll, include it when finding the worst target modifiers, as normal; do not make a separate roll or rescore outcomes for other targets. If players defend separately against an NPC area, it benefits only its own recipient. This is defensive interference, not cancellation; the resulting spell outcome still resolves.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Show a threatening reflection from water, then ride the current toward an escape route. A blinded target cannot see the reflection.

**Encounter and conversation:** She keeps the names of drowned sailors in a shell chest and will trade one for a promise made on dry land.

**Habitat:** Old woodland; crossroads; hidden court · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-sea-hag


**Category:** Fey · **Role:** Fear controller · **CV:** 23

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Drowned reflection | Reason | 1 Boon | 3 mental damage. | 5 mental damage. Frightened 1 of this creature. | 7 mental damage. Frightened 2 of this creature. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** mental

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.45

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.45: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=5.000, O=5.596. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [dread cry](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/dread-cry.md), [Ride the Current](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/read-the-current.md), [Spell Screen](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/spell-screen.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Dread Cry

*Its cry seems to come from somewhere behind your ribs.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-dread-cry


**Action:** Main Action

A printed mental attack applies Frightened 1/2/3 on Weak/Standard/Strong, with no damage unless separately printed. The source is this creature; Banes apply while the target perceives it. The cry must be heard. Ordinary decay applies and no second save is made.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
